title: Trustworthy AI

sourceEvidence.locator: A system can be accurate on a benchmark
sourceEvidence.excerpt: A system can be accurate on a benchmark and still be unsafe in a workflow because the benchmark says little about users, authority, latency, data quality or consequences. This distinction matters because the same numerical result can support very different conclusions depending on the deployment context. hook: The benchmark looks excellent; the system still fails the person relying on it.
readerPromise: Builders and reviewers encounter the evidence behind a promise people increasingly have to trust. Before an AI acts for someone, what should that promise be able to withstand?
